subject: One killed and dozens hurt in train collision north of London
posts:

Evidence: Public safety, Systemic failure, Infrastructure integrity. 
#London #RailSafety 🌐

Two London-bound trains collided near Bedford on Friday. East Midlands Railway confirmed the fatality, while emergency services treated over 80 people for varying injuries.
